SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I bought the souvenir you requested from Kyoto.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I see. But I don't need it anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? What's with that, what do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I changed my mind and there isn't any other reason.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-W-Wait... Did something happen while I was at Kyoto?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Not really.
[FI] Something DID happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Anyway, let's go home together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Together... with you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We can't?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmph, is it necessary to do such a thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There isn't any reason for me to go home together with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We can't go home together without a reason?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes, that's right. Any action must have an accompanying valid aim.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Aimless actions, are as pointless as dead leaves floating in water.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh...
[FI] But still... Isn't she being unnaturally peculiar? This girl...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh?
[FI] W-What is she saying? This girl...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Did you not hear me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Then I shall re-iterate, there isn't any reason for me to go home with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You don't have to say it so bluntly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm... I simply wish that you would understand it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I cannot be in your presence.
[FI] What's going on? Doesn't Kuroneko seem strange?
[FI] Then, what should I do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Sorry, but I don't have the time to play around right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Goodbye then, senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kuroneko, can I ask you something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What would that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Uh, it's just a theory...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] C-Could it be that you have someone you're interested in?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-Why would that be the case?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-I see... I can finally relax a little...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-Why did you say such a confusing thing all of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That sounded really cold... I'll get lonely...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Isn't that your problem? I have my own matters to attend to.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh, what kind of matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I need not tell you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Furthermore, being lonely is a lie, am I right? Senpai already has Belphegor... no, Tamura-senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why did you mention Manami here? She doesn't have anything to do with this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Besides, it's true that I'll get lonely if you're not around.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ......I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Senpai, I'll take the chance to make it clear to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Don't get involved with me any further.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's that, trying out a new joke?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If that's what you think, you're really a happy-go-lucky person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's because I wanted it to be a joke! Because...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Because... of what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Won't I feel lonely if that's not the case?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Even if you give me that look, that won't change my mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's that supposed to mean? I don't get it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It doesn't matter if you don't get it, I just wanted to tell you that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You have to give me a reason, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't need to give one, it is useless even if I do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why is it useless? How would you know if you don't say it out?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] The outcome will be better for both of us that way...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I-Isn't there things you ought to do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-Things I ought to do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Good grief... Isn't senpai preparing for his exams?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do you understand now? We both have things we need to do. So it is for our mutual sake to do so.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you think I'll just accept that? Explain yourself properly!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Don't presume that you can get people to tell you everything you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There are many things that people can't say to others.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't get it at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, that's perfectly fine. I also thought you wouldn't understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's with that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Useless means useless.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Right now, your will is nothing but an hindrance for my soul. That is why I have to distance myself from you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's that about...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It is as I said.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This marks the end of our conversation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey? What's gotten into you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I have no need nor obligation to answer you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you really have to say it like that? Even though I'm worried about you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Can you not be so depressed? It's unsightly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hold it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There is nothing more I have to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You said "don't get involved with me any further" earlier on... Are you serious about that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes, I am.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Don't get involved with me anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's... with that...
[FI] I'm somehow feeling quite depressed.
[FI] I'm even shocked at myself, why... do I... feel so sad?
